title: Single-Band Parametric EQ
text: Second-order parametric equalizer filter, 5 inputs, 1 output, no direct feedthrough; {Filter order} sets the order of filter, {Filter specification} sets the parameters used to design filter Bandwidth and center, {Center Frequency (Hz)} sets the center frequency of filter, {Filter Bandwidth (Hz)} sets the bandwidth of filter, {Quality Factor}, {Peak Gain (dB)} sets the peak or dip gain of filter, {Inherit sample rate from input} sets the source of input sample rate, {Input sample rate (Hz)} sets the sample rate of input and {Simulate using} sets the type of simulation to run. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Filter order
params.values: Order of filter 2 (default) | positive even scalar

params.name: Filter specification
params.values: Specify parameters used to design filter Bandwidth and center frequency (default) | Quality factor and center frequency

params.name: Center Frequency (Hz)
params.values: Center frequency of filter 11025 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Filter Bandwidth (Hz)
params.values: Bandwidth of filter 2205 (default) | positive scalar in the range [0, max(fs/2, 20,000)]

params.name: Quality Factor
params.values: Quality factor 5 (default) | scalar in the range [0.1, 20]

params.name: Peak Gain (dB)
params.values: Peak or dip gain of filter 6.0206 (default) | scalar in the range [−30, 30]

params.name: Inherit sample rate from input
params.values: Specify source of input sample rate on (default) | off

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: Specify type of simulation to run Code generation (default) | Interpreted execution
